messages:
maria: Hey team — I pushed updates for the batching PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1723). Addressed all review comments and added a short note about the timeout change. PTAL when you have a sec.

jordan: Thanks — I'll pull and run the unit tests locally this afternoon. Quick question: did you keep the previous semantics for `max_batch_size`?

maria: Yes, semantics unchanged. I only changed the internal buffering logic and bumped the test timeout from 2s -> 5s. Comment in code: `// increased timeout due to CI flakiness on low-QPS runners`

sam: CI already kicked — looks like one flaky integration still failed (batcher_integration.test_timeout). Can you add a short retry in the test harness? :eyes:

maria: Good catch. I added a single retry wrapper in the test — pushed a new commit. Also rebased on main to pick up the infra fix.

ci-bot: Build #1921 triggered for PR1723 — tests running.

jordan: Ran the unit suite locally, everything green. Left a tiny nit: prefer `bufferedBatch` -> `batchBuffer` for clarity. Nothing functional.

maria: Nit fixed, pushed. Also included a micro-benchmark: `bench_batch_latency` shows ~2% lower p50. Paste here in case it's useful: ```
// p50 baseline: 12.3ms -> now 12.1ms
```

sam: Looks good to me. Approving once CI is green. :thumbsup:

jordan: Approving as well. If the canary passes, feel free to merge. I have a small window before PTO tomorrow, so prefer today.

maria: Thanks both — I'll watch CI and merge on green. Appreciate the quick reviews! :tada:
